properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_store_an_older_reflow2_wrote_is_rechecked.rs, over the built binary. A RocksDB store written under the pre-narrowing endpoints holds REALIZES Artifact -> Decision and VERIFIES Verification -> Decision (triage C's two shapes). `--call detect_defects` reports both as critical refused_by_schema findings naming DOCUMENTS and GOVERNED_BY; `--export` still succeeds; `--import` of that export into a fresh store refuses exactly those two items, naming the same replacements.
properties.name: The binary names what its import would refuse, on a store an older reflow2 wrote
